assertions: TaskSGE6BG implements controlled React/Tailwind Calc presenters for native grid,input-window and sheet-tab responsibilities. They consume actual ScViewData/ScMarkData and controller display/input projections,never a second cell,selection or draft model. The grid paints a bounded viewport on a full-domain scroll canvas,with logical ARIA coordinates,source active/marked cell state,headers,inline edit focus and unchanged keyboard/pointer/IME intents. Input-window function/sum/equals and OK/cancel composition follows native mode switching. Tabs read actual sheet names and selected/active identities. Native commands,formatting,draft state and navigation stay with their controllers. Exact Writer toolbar-button styles are extracted into framework/browser/presentation/office-control-styles.ts and shared by Writer/Calc; global fonts,slate/indigo palette,Tailwind,rounded states and Lucide icons are reused. This task implements presentation contracts,not a registered production Calc module or complete editable workbench.

stackDivergence.rationale: React/DOM replace VCL painting while original composition,model/view ownership and controller-input boundaries are preserved for the represented presenters;Writer shared styles and icons are reused.

record.capability: Controlled Calc grid,input-line and sheet-tab presenters
gaps: Production Calc module registration,document/input/view command controllers,shared menus/toolbars,status/sidebar,file dialogs,ODS workflows,primary storage/autosave and close prompts remain following UI tasks.
Column/row resizing,drag selection,hidden/merged/formatted cells,panes,functions and names require their actual core/view services;no no-op services or whole native/UI fidelity claim.
Native UI test anchors are reference callers only,not executed upstream suites. Task-local preview journals intents;it does not implement substitute document commands.
